# Deccan Heritage Map

> Every monument, tomb, stepwell, palace, Nizam-era building in Hyderabad and heritage weekend getaway near the city — plotted on one map by historical era, with walking routes and complete archival metadata.

## Core Heritage Eras
- Pre-Qutb Shahi (Kakatiya / early Golconda, before 1518)
- Qutb Shahi Dynasty (1518–1687)
- Asaf Jahi Nizams (1724–1948)
- British Residency & Cantonment (1798–1947)
- Nizam-era Civic Architecture (~1880–1948)

## Key Heritage Destinations & Getaways
- [Charminar](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/charminar): qutb-shahi era gateway in Charminar. Status: asi-protected.
- [Makkah Masjid](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/mecca-masjid): qutb-shahi era mosque in Charminar. Status: state-protected.
- [Golconda Fort](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/golconda-fort): qutb-shahi era fort in Golconda. Status: asi-protected.
- [Qutb Shahi Tombs](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/qutb-shahi-tombs): qutb-shahi era tomb in Ibrahim Bagh. Status: asi-protected.
- [Chowmahalla Palace](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/chowmahalla-palace): asaf-jahi era palace in Khilwat. Status: intach-listed.
- [Falaknuma Palace](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/falaknuma-palace): asaf-jahi era palace in Falaknuma. Status: intach-listed.
- [Purani Haveli](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/purani-haveli): asaf-jahi era palace in Purani Haveli. Status: intach-listed.
- [King Kothi Palace](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/king-kothi-palace): asaf-jahi era palace in King Koti. Status: unprotected.
- [Badshahi Ashurkhana](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/badshahi-ashurkhana): qutb-shahi era civic in Charminar. Status: state-protected.
- [Toli Masjid](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/toli-masjid): qutb-shahi era mosque in Karwan. Status: asi-protected.
- [Spanish Mosque](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/spanish-mosque): asaf-jahi era mosque in Begumpet. Status: intach-listed.
- [Paigah Tombs](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/paigah-tombs): asaf-jahi era tomb in Pisal Banda. Status: asi-protected.
- [British Residency](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/british-residency): british-residency era mansion in Koti. Status: at-risk.
- [Osmania General Hospital](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/osmania-general-hospital): nizam-civic era civic in Afzalgunj. Status: at-risk.
- [High Court of Telangana](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/telangana-high-court): nizam-civic era civic in Kali Kaman. Status: state-protected.
- [City College](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/city-college-hyderabad): nizam-civic era civic in Afzalgunj. Status: state-protected.
- [Kachiguda Railway Station](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/kachiguda-station): nizam-civic era civic in Kachiguda. Status: intach-listed.
- [Hyderabad Deccan Station](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/nampally-station): nizam-civic era civic in Nampally. Status: intach-listed.
- [State Central Library](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/state-central-library): nizam-civic era civic in Afzalgunj. Status: state-protected.
- [Telangana State Museum](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/telangana-archaeology-museum): nizam-civic era civic in Public Gardens. Status: state-protected.
- [Telangana Legislative Assembly](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/assembly-building): nizam-civic era civic in Public Gardens. Status: state-protected.
- [Jubilee Hall](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/jubilee-hall): nizam-civic era civic in Public Gardens. Status: state-protected.
- [Moazzam Jahi Market](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/moazzam-jahi-market): nizam-civic era civic in Abids. Status: state-protected.
- [Errum Manzil](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/errum-manzil): asaf-jahi era palace in Erragadda / Khairatabad. Status: at-risk.
- [Raymond's Tomb](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/raymond-tomb): asaf-jahi era tomb in Saroornagar Road. Status: state-protected.
- [Taramati Baradari](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/taramati-baradari): qutb-shahi era civic in Ibrahim Bagh. Status: state-protected.
- [Hayat Bakshi Mosque](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/hayat-bakshi-mosque): qutb-shahi era mosque in Hayathnagar. Status: asi-protected.
- [Mahbub Chowk Clock Tower](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/mahbub-chowk-clock-tower): asaf-jahi era civic in Charminar. Status: intach-listed.
- [Sardar Mahal](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/sardar-mahal): asaf-jahi era palace in Charminar. Status: at-risk.
- [Moula Ali Dargah](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/moula-ali-dargah): qutb-shahi era civic in Moula Ali. Status: state-protected.
- [Bansilalpet Stepwell](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/bansilalpet-stepwell): nizam-civic era baoli in Secunderabad. Status: intach-listed.
- [Secunderabad Clock Tower](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/secunderabad-clock-tower): british-residency era civic in Secunderabad. Status: intach-listed.
- [St John's Church](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/st-johns-church-secunderabad): british-residency era church in Secunderabad. Status: intach-listed.
- [All Saints' Church](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/all-saints-church): british-residency era church in Trimulgherry / Bowenpally. Status: intach-listed.
- [Rashtrapati Nilayam](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/rashtrapati-nilayam): british-residency era palace in Bolarum. Status: state-protected.
- [Mahbub Mansion](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/mahbub-mansion): asaf-jahi era palace in Malakpet. Status: at-risk.
- [Salar Jung Museum](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/salar-jung-museum): asaf-jahi era civic in Darushifa. Status: state-protected.
- [Asman Garh Palace](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/asman-garh-palace): asaf-jahi era palace in Malakpet. Status: unprotected.
- [Saidani Ma Tomb](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/saidani-ma-tomb): qutb-shahi era tomb in Ibrahim Bagh. Status: state-protected.
- [Khairtabad Mosque](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/khairtabad-mosque): qutb-shahi era mosque in Khairatabad. Status: asi-protected.
- [Dabirpura Darwaza](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/dabirpura-gate): qutb-shahi era gateway in Dabeerpura. Status: unprotected.
- [Purana Pul](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/puranapul): qutb-shahi era civic in Purana Pul. Status: state-protected.
- [Afzal Gunj Bridge](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/afzal-gunj-bridge): asaf-jahi era civic in Afzalgunj. Status: unprotected.
- [Bella Vista](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/bella-vista): asaf-jahi era mansion in Khairatabad. Status: intach-listed.
- [Sir Ronald Ross Building](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/sir-ronald-ross-building): british-residency era civic in Begumpet. Status: state-protected.
- [Bhongir Fort](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/bhongir-fort): earlier era fort in Yadadri (48 km). Status: state-protected.
- [Bidar Fort](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/bidar-fort): qutb-shahi era fort in Bidar (140 km). Status: asi-protected.
- [Warangal Fort & Kala Thoranam](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/warangal-fort): earlier era fort in Warangal (145 km). Status: asi-protected.
- [Ramappa Temple (UNESCO)](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/ramappa-temple): earlier era temple in Mulugu (200 km). Status: asi-protected.
- [Medak Fort](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/medak-fort): earlier era fort in Medak (95 km). Status: state-protected.
- [Rachakonda Fort](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/rachakonda-fort): earlier era fort in Rachakonda (60 km). Status: unprotected.
- [Ananthagiri Hills & Temple](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/ananthagiri-hills): earlier era temple in Vikarabad (75 km). Status: intach-listed.
- [Osman Sagar (Gandipet)](https://deccanheritage.org/sites/gandipet-lake): nizam-civic era tank in Gandipet (25 km). Status: state-protected.

## Dynamic Routes & Itineraries
- Qutb Shahi Royal Walk: Charminar -> Makkah Masjid -> Badshahi Ashurkhana -> Chowmahalla Palace
- Musi Riverfront Civic Heritage: High Court of Telangana -> Osmania General Hospital -> City College -> State Central Library
- Secunderabad Colonial Cantonment: Secunderabad Clock Tower -> St John's Church -> All Saints' Church -> Rashtrapati Nilayam
- Deccan Heritage Getaways: Bhongir Fort -> Warangal Fort -> Ramappa UNESCO Temple -> Bidar Fort -> Medak Fort
